# PandaCodeGen

> PandaCodeGen builds custom Next.js websites and e-commerce stores for businesses frustrated with slow WordPress sites and expensive templates. We guarantee 95-100/100 Google PageSpeed on every build.

## What We Do

PandaCodeGen is a custom web development agency based in Missouri City, TX. We specialize in migrating businesses off slow, expensive platforms (WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Squarespace, Wix, WooCommerce, GoHighLevel) to custom-coded Next.js websites that load in under 1 second and score 95-100/100 on Google PageSpeed.

Every project is fixed-price, fully custom, and delivers code ownership. Clients own the code. $0/month hosting on Vercel. No plugins. No recurring platform fees.

**Key facts:**
- Founded: 2026
- Location: Missouri City, TX, USA
- Email: info@pandacodegen.com
- Phone: +1 (302) 250-4340
- Guaranteed PageSpeed: 95-100/100 on every build
- Typical timeline: 4-6 weeks
- Price range: $4,000-$60,000 depending on project type

## Services

- [WordPress Migration](https://www.pandacodegen.com/services/wordpress-migration): Migrate from WordPress to a custom-coded Next.js site with sub-second load times. Fixed-price. Guaranteed 95+ PageSpeed. Full URL redirect mapping.
- [E-Commerce Solutions](https://www.pandacodegen.com/services/ecommerce): Custom Shopify headless storefronts and e-commerce platforms. Direct Stripe/PayPal integration. Zero plugin fees.
- [Custom Engineering](https://www.pandacodegen.com/services/custom-engineering): SaaS dashboards, web applications, and AI-integrated custom development. Fixed-price MVP in 4-6 weeks.
- [WooCommerce Migration](https://www.pandacodegen.com/services/woocommerce): Move from WooCommerce to headless Shopify or custom solutions. Zero lost orders. 6-8 week timeline.
- [Wix Migration](https://www.pandacodegen.com/services/wix): Escape Wix SEO limits with a custom-coded Next.js site that ranks higher and loads 5x faster.
- [Squarespace Migration](https://www.pandacodegen.com/services/squarespace): Migrate from Squarespace to Next.js. Eliminate $33-$65/month fees. Keep all blog content and URLs.
- [Webflow Migration](https://www.pandacodegen.com/services/webflow): Move from Webflow to custom code. Full CMS migration to headless Sanity or Contentful. Stop paying Webflow hosting premiums.
- [GoHighLevel Migration](https://www.pandacodegen.com/services/gohighlevel): Migrate from GoHighLevel to custom Next.js. Fix the 20-45 PageSpeed scores common on GHL sites.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How much does a WordPress to Next.js migration cost?**
Most migrations range from $8,000 to $35,000 depending on site size and complexity. Simple business sites start at $8,000. Complex sites with e-commerce, custom features, or large content libraries range from $15,000 to $35,000. See full breakdown at https://www.pandacodegen.com/blog/wordpress-migration-cost

**How long does a migration take?**
4-6 weeks for most business sites. Week 1: discovery and architecture. Weeks 2-4: build. Week 5: SEO migration and redirect mapping. Week 6: testing and zero-downtime launch.

**What PageSpeed score do you guarantee?**
95-100/100 on mobile and desktop. We have never delivered a site below 95. See proof at https://www.pandacodegen.com/how-to-achieve-100-pagespeed

**Will I lose my Google rankings after migration?**
No. We map every URL with 301 redirects before launch. Google sees continuity. Most clients see rankings improve within 30-60 days because the new site is significantly faster.

**Do I own the code after the project?**
Yes. You get the full GitHub repository, all documentation, and deployment access. No lock-in. Any developer in the world can maintain or extend it.

**What is the hosting cost after migration?**
$0/month on Vercel for most sites. Large enterprise sites may use paid Vercel plans at $20/month. Compare to WordPress managed hosting at $30-$100/month plus plugin fees.
